# RoxyApi .NET SDK - Complete Method Reference

> .NET SDK for RoxyAPI. Multi-domain spiritual and metaphysical intelligence API. Fully typed, generated from the OpenAPI spec. Install: `dotnet add package RoxyApi.Sdk`

```csharp
using RoxyApi;
using RoxyApi.Models;
using Microsoft.Kiota.Abstractions; // the Date type

var roxy = new RoxyClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ROXY_API_KEY")!);
```

How the calls below map to the API:

- **The fluent path mirrors the URL.** `GET /astrology/horoscope/{sign}/daily` is `roxy.Astrology.Horoscope["aries"].Daily.GetAsync()`. Each path segment is a property; each `{param}` is an indexer.
- **Request bodies use a target-typed `new()`.** The body type is inferred from the method, so you never name it. Property names are the PascalCase of the JSON fields (`birth_date` becomes `BirthDate`).
- **Query parameters use a configuration lambda.** `await roxy.Crystals.Search.GetAsync(c => c.QueryParameters.Q = "amethyst");`
- **Dates use `new Date(year, month, day)`; times use `new Time(hour, minute, second)`** (both from `Microsoft.Kiota.Abstractions`).
- **`Timezone` is a union:** `new() { Double = -5 }` (decimal offset) or `new() { String = "America/New_York" }` (IANA name, resolved to the DST-correct offset).
- **Every call is async and throws `RoxyError` on a 4xx or 5xx.** Capture the result directly: `var chart = await roxy.Astrology.NatalChart.PostAsync(new() { ... });`

**Multi-language responses.** Interpretations are available in 10 languages: en, tr, de, es, fr, hi, pt, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant. Add `c => c.QueryParameters.Lang = "es"` to any supported endpoint. Supported: astrology, vedicAstrology, forecast, humanDesign, chineseAstrology, fengShui, mesoamericanAstrology, vastu, numerology, kabbalah, tarot, biorhythm, ayurveda, iching, crystals, angelNumbers. English-only: dreams, location, usage, languages. The two Chinese scripts currently ship on chineseAstrology and fengShui. Untranslated fields fall back to English.

---

## Western Astrology - `roxy.Astrology`

Western astrology API for natal birth charts, daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly horoscopes with unique content per s...

```csharp
// Get all zodiac signs - Complete zodiac signs list with dates and elements
await roxy.Astrology.Signs.GetAsync();

// Get zodiac sign details - Complete astrology sign profile with personality traits
await roxy.Astrology.Signs["aries"].GetAsync();

// Get all planet meanings - Complete astrology planet interpretations list
await roxy.Astrology.PlanetMeanings.GetAsync();

// Get planet meaning details - Complete astrology planet interpretation
await roxy.Astrology.PlanetMeanings["sun"].GetAsync();

// Generate natal chart - Birth chart calculator API with houses and aspects
await roxy.Astrology.NatalChart.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } });

// Get planetary positions - Ephemeris calculator for all planets
await roxy.Astrology.Planets.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(2025, 12, 18), Time = new Time(12, 0, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } });

// Monthly Ephemeris - Daily tropical planetary positions for a month
await roxy.Astrology.Planets.Monthly.PostAsync(new() { Year = 2026, Month = 8 });

// Get current moon phase - Lunar phase calculator with zodiac sign
await roxy.Astrology.MoonPhase.Current.GetAsync(c => { c.QueryParameters.Date = new Date(2025, 12, 18); c.QueryParameters.Time = new Time(12, 0, 0); c.QueryParameters.Timezone = "America/New_York"; });

// Get upcoming moon phases - Next new moon, full moon, quarters
await roxy.Astrology.MoonPhase.Upcoming.GetAsync(c => { c.QueryParameters.StartDate = new Date(2025, 12, 18); c.QueryParameters.Count = 8; });

// Get lunar calendar - Moon phases for entire month
await roxy.Astrology.MoonPhase.Calendar[2026][3].GetAsync();

// Calculate synastry - Relationship compatibility analysis API
await roxy.Astrology.Synastry.PostAsync(new() { Person1 = new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 }, Name = "Alex" }, Person2 = new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 }, Name = "Alex" } });

// Calculate house cusps - House system calculator with comparison
await roxy.Astrology.Houses.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } });

// Calculate planetary aspects - Aspect finder for any date and time
await roxy.Astrology.Aspects.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Timezone = new() { Double = -5 }, Planets = ["Sun"], AspectTypes = ["CONJUNCTION"] });

// Monthly Aspects - Tropical aspect calendar for an entire month
await roxy.Astrology.Aspects.Monthly.PostAsync(new() { Year = 2026, Month = 3, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } });

// Detect aspect patterns - Grand Trine, Kite, T-Square, Grand Cross, Yod, Mystic Rectangle, Stellium
await roxy.Astrology.AspectPatterns.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } }, c => { c.QueryParameters.StrictOrbs = "false"; c.QueryParameters.Include = ""; });

// Calculate planetary transits - Current transits with natal chart comparison
await roxy.Astrology.Transits.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(2025, 12, 19), Time = new Time(12, 0, 0), Timezone = new() { Double = 0 } });

// Monthly Transits - Tropical sign ingresses for an entire month
await roxy.Astrology.Transits.Monthly.PostAsync(new() { Year = 2026, Month = 3, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } });

// Transit Aspects - Detailed transit-to-natal aspect analysis with interpretations
await roxy.Astrology.TransitAspects.PostAsync(new() { NatalChart = new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } }, TransitDate = new Date(2026, 2, 3), TransitTime = new Time(12, 0, 0), MinStrength = 50 });

// Monthly Parallels - Declination contacts for an entire month
await roxy.Astrology.Parallels.Monthly.PostAsync(new() { Year = 2026, Month = 3, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 }, Orb = 1.5 });

// Ecliptic Crossings - Node passages for a whole year
await roxy.Astrology.EclipticCrossings.PostAsync(new() { Year = 2026, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } });

// Solar Return Chart - Annual birthday forecast with relocated chart
await roxy.Astrology.SolarReturn.PostAsync(new() { BirthDate = new Date(1990, 7, 15), BirthTime = new Time(14, 30, 0), ReturnYear = 2026, Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } });

// Lunar Return Chart - Monthly emotional forecast with Moon cycle chart
await roxy.Astrology.LunarReturn.PostAsync(new() { BirthDate = new Date(1990, 7, 15), BirthTime = new Time(14, 30, 0), ReturnDate = new Date(2026, 2, 12), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } });

// Composite Chart - Midpoint relationship chart with interpretations
await roxy.Astrology.CompositeChart.PostAsync(new() { Person1 = new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } }, Person2 = new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } } });

// Compatibility score - Relationship compatibility API
await roxy.Astrology.CompatibilityScore.PostAsync(new() { Person1 = new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } }, Person2 = new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } } });

// Daily horoscope by zodiac sign - Transit-based editorial columns
await roxy.Astrology.Horoscope["aries"].Daily.GetAsync(c => { c.QueryParameters.Date = new Date(2026, 4, 3); c.QueryParameters.Timezone = "America/New_York"; });

// Weekly horoscope by zodiac sign - Seven-day editorial column
await roxy.Astrology.Horoscope["aries"].Weekly.GetAsync(c => { c.QueryParameters.Date = new Date(2026, 4, 3); c.QueryParameters.Timezone = "America/New_York"; });

// Monthly horoscope by zodiac sign - Editorial column with key dates
await roxy.Astrology.Horoscope["aries"].Monthly.GetAsync(c => { c.QueryParameters.Date = new Date(2026, 4, 3); c.QueryParameters.Timezone = "America/New_York"; });

// Yearly horoscope by zodiac sign - Year ahead forecast with themes, key periods, eclipses and retrogrades
await roxy.Astrology.Horoscope["aries"].Yearly.GetAsync(c => { c.QueryParameters.Year = 2026; c.QueryParameters.Timezone = "America/New_York"; });

// Planetary Return Chart - Saturn return, Jupiter return, and inner planet cycles
await roxy.Astrology.PlanetaryReturns.PostAsync(new() { BirthDate = new Date(1990, 7, 15), BirthTime = new Time(14, 30, 0), ApproximateDate = new Date(2026, 8, 15), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } });

// Astrocartography map - planetary lines and relocation calculator
await roxy.Astrology.Astrocartography.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } }, c => c.QueryParameters.Include = "chiron");

// Generate relocation chart - Relocated birth chart calculator with shifted houses and angles
await roxy.Astrology.RelocationChart.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1961, 8, 4), Time = new Time(19, 24, 0), Timezone = new() { Double = -10 }, BirthLatitude = 21.3069, BirthLongitude = -157.8583, RelocationLatitude = 40.7167, RelocationLongitude = -74.006 });

// Local space astrology map - Directional planetary compass lines
await roxy.Astrology.LocalSpace.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } }, c => c.QueryParameters.Include = "chiron,lilith");

// Fixed stars and star conjunctions calculator - Regulus, Spica, Algol natal report
await roxy.Astrology.FixedStars.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } }, c => c.QueryParameters.Orb = 1);

// Arabic lots calculator - seven Hermetic parts including Part of Fortune and Spirit
await roxy.Astrology.ArabicLots.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } });

// Asteroid goddesses calculator - Ceres, Pallas, Juno, and Vesta natal positions
await roxy.Astrology.Asteroids.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } });

// Black Moon Lilith calculator - mean and true lunar apogee in the natal chart
await roxy.Astrology.Lilith.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 } });

// Secondary progressions calculator - progressed chart, progressed Sun and Moon
await roxy.Astrology.Progressions.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 }, TargetDate = new Date(2025, 7, 15) });

// Solar arc directions calculator - directed chart at one degree per year
await roxy.Astrology.SolarArc.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 }, TargetDate = new Date(2025, 7, 15) });

// Annual profections calculator - lord of the year and yearly time lord by age
await roxy.Astrology.Profections.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 15), Time = new Time(14, 30, 0), Latitude = 40.7128, Longitude = -74.006, Timezone = new() { Double = -5 }, TargetDate = new Date(2025, 8, 4) });
```

## Vedic Astrology - `roxy.VedicAstrology`

Vedic astrology (Jyotish) and KP API for kundli generation with 15 divisional charts (D1-D60), Ashtakoot Gun Milan ku...

```csharp
// Get birth chart (D1 Rashi chart) - Kundli Calculator API

await roxy.VedicAstrology.Navamsa.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 4), Time = new Time(10, 12, 0), Latitude = 28.6139, Longitude = 77.209, Timezone = new() { Double = 5.5 }, AyanamsaValue = 24 });

// Get divisional chart (Varga) - D2 to D60 Calculator
await roxy.VedicAstrology.DivisionalChart.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 4), Time = new Time(10, 12, 0), Latitude = 28.6139, Longitude = 77.209, Timezone = new() { Double = 5.5 }, AyanamsaValue = 24, Division = 10 });

// Calculate compatibility score - Gun Milan API (Ashtakoot Matching)
await roxy.VedicAstrology.Compatibility.PostAsync(new() { Person1 = new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 4), Time = new Time(10, 12, 0), Latitude = 28.6139, Longitude = 77.209, Timezone = new() { Double = 5.5 } }, Person2 = new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 4), Time = new Time(10, 12, 0), Latitude = 28.6139, Longitude = 77.209, Timezone = new() { Double = 5.5 } }, AyanamsaValue = 24 });

await roxy.VedicAstrology.PlanetaryPositions.Monthly.PostAsync(new() { Year = 2026, Month = 2 });

await roxy.VedicAstrology.Dasha.Current.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 4), Time = new Time(10, 12, 0), Latitude = 28.6139, Longitude = 77.209, Timezone = new() { Double = 5.5 }, AyanamsaValue = 24, Significators = false });

await roxy.VedicAstrology.Dasha.Major.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 4), Time = new Time(10, 12, 0), Latitude = 28.6139, Longitude = 77.209, Timezone = new() { Double = 5.5 }, AyanamsaValue = 24, Significators = false });

// Get all Pratyantardashas (antara periods) for a Mahadasha and Antardasha
await roxy.VedicAstrology.Dasha.Sub["Saturn"]["Venus"].PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 4), Time = new Time(10, 12, 0), Latitude = 28.6139, Longitude = 77.209, Timezone = new() { Double = 5.5 }, AyanamsaValue = 24, Significators = false });

// Get all Sookshma dashas for a Mahadasha, Antardasha and Pratyantardasha
await roxy.VedicAstrology.Dasha.Sub["Saturn"]["Venus"]["Rahu"].PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 4), Time = new Time(10, 12, 0), Latitude = 28.6139, Longitude = 77.209, Timezone = new() { Double = 5.5 }, AyanamsaValue = 24, Significators = false });

// Get all Prana dashas for a Mahadasha, Antardasha, Pratyantardasha and Sookshma
await roxy.VedicAstrology.Dasha.Sub["Saturn"]["Venus"]["Rahu"]["Jupiter"].PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(1990, 7, 4), Time = new Time(10, 12, 0), Latitude = 28.6139, Longitude = 77.209, Timezone = new() { Double = 5.5 }, AyanamsaValue = 24, Significators = false });

// Daily Reading - Composed Gochara, Panchanga and Dasha for one native on one day
await roxy.VedicAstrology.Daily.PostAsync(new() { BirthDate = new Date(1984, 11, 3), BirthTime = new Time(1, 35, 0), Latitude = 28.8944, Longitude = 76.5894, Timezone = new() { Double = 5.5 }, Date = new Date(2026, 6, 21) });

// Get basic Panchang - Tithi Nakshatra Yoga Karana Calculator
await roxy.VedicAstrology.Panchang.Basic.PostAsync(new() { Date = new Date(2025, 12, 17), Time = new Time(12, 0, 0), Latitude = 28.6139, Longitude = 77.209, Timezone = new() { Double = 5.5 } });
```

Tarot reading API with the complete 78-card Rider-Waite-Smith deck and card meanings for love, career, health, and sp...

```csharp
// List all 78 tarot cards - Tarot deck catalog API
await roxy.Tarot.Cards.GetAsync(c => { c.QueryParameters.Limit = 20; c.QueryParameters.Offset = 0; c.QueryParameters.Number = 1; });

// Get tarot card by id - Tarot card meaning API
await roxy.Tarot.Cards["fool"].GetAsync();

// Draw tarot cards - Seeded tarot draw API
await roxy.Tarot.Draw.PostAsync(new() { Count = 3, Seed = "user123-2025-12-27", AllowReversals = true, AllowDuplicates = false });

// Daily tarot card - Card of the day API
await roxy.Tarot.Daily.PostAsync(new() { Seed = "user123", Date = new Date(2026, 3, 6) });

// Yes or no answer - Yes no tarot reading API
await roxy.Tarot.YesNo.PostAsync(new() { Question = "Should I accept the job offer?", Seed = "reading-2f9c1a" });

// Three card spread, past present future - Tarot spread API
await roxy.Tarot.Spreads.ThreeCard.PostAsync(new() { Question = "What do I need to know about my career?", Seed = "reading-2f9c1a" });

// Celtic Cross spread, 10 cards - Tarot spread API
await roxy.Tarot.Spreads.CelticCross.PostAsync(new() { Question = "What should I know about this situation?", Seed = "reading-2f9c1a" });

// Love spread, 5 cards - Relationship tarot reading API
await roxy.Tarot.Spreads.Love.PostAsync(new() { Question = "What do I need to know about my relationship?", Seed = "reading-2f9c1a" });

// Career spread, 7 cards - Career tarot reading API
await roxy.Tarot.Spreads.Career.PostAsync(new() { Question = "What do I need to know about my career path?", Seed = "reading-2f9c1a" });

// Custom spread builder - Configurable tarot spread API
await roxy.Tarot.Spreads.Custom.PostAsync(new() { SpreadName = "My Custom Spread", Positions = [new() { Name = "Core Issue", Interpretation = "What is really going on" }], Question = "How do I move forward with this project?", Seed = "reading-2f9c1a" });
```

```csharp
// Get phase info - Lightweight cycle status for dashboards and widgets
```

```csharp
// Ayurvedic constitution from a birth chart - Dosha profile API

// Ayurveda seasonal regimen - Ritucharya and ritu resolution API
```

## Error handling

Calls throw `RoxyApi.Models.RoxyError` (a subclass of `Microsoft.Kiota.Abstractions.ApiException`) on a 4xx or 5xx response.

```csharp
try
{
    var chart = await roxy.Astrology.NatalChart.PostAsync(new() { /* ... */ });
}
catch (RoxyApi.Models.RoxyError e)
{
    // e.Code is stable (switch on it); e.Message may change wording.
    // e.ResponseStatusCode is the HTTP status. On a 400, e.Issues lists each invalid field.
    Console.WriteLine($"{e.ResponseStatusCode} {e.Code}: {e.Message}");
}
```

Codes: validation_error (400), api_key_required / invalid_api_key / subscription_not_found / subscription_inactive (401), not_found (404), rate_limit_exceeded (429), internal_error (500).

## Advanced

`new RoxyClient(apiKey)` is the common path. For a custom `HttpClient`, proxy, or middleware, build the client from a Kiota request adapter:

```csharp
using Microsoft.Kiota.Http.HttpClientLibrary;

var adapter = new HttpClientRequestAdapter(authProvider, httpClient: yourHttpClient);
var roxy = new RoxyClient(adapter);
```
